description: This Java class is a Spring MVC controller handling admin login, logout, and access denied pages.

classes.name: LoginController
classes.description: Handles login, logout, and unauthorized access requests for the admin section.

methods.name: displayLogin
methods.description: Displays the login page when accessed via GET at /admin/logon.html.

methods.name: displayDenied
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page upon access denial at /admin/denied.html.

methods.name: unauthorized
methods.description: Displays the unauthorized access page at /admin/unauthorized.html.
